subject: Re: creating a shinyapps.io hosted app to a remote MySQL connection

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: creating a shinyapps.io hosted app to a remote MySQL connection
parts:
In all likelihood, a database running on your laptop is not accessible from the shinyapps.io servers. If you are running on a corporate or campus network, you should contact your network administrator and discuss with them how to get this setup properly. In short your laptop running the database will need a public IP address and firewall rules to allow the shinyapps.io servers to connect to it.

Your other option would be to host your database using a 3rd party service such as Amazon RDS which can be configured to allow connections from shinyapps.io servers.

Hope that helps
-Andy

On Thu, Jul 16, 2015 at 2:27 PM, <anthon...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi all, 

I have been struggling to establish a connection from my deployed shinyapps.io hosted app to MySQL, currently hosted on my personal laptop. I run the app locally using the runApp function with no issues at all but once I have deployed the app I cannot establish a connection. This is for development purposes only.

Error in .local(drv, ...) : 

Failed to connect to database: Error: Can't connect to MySQL server on '127.0.0.1' (111)

The follow have been addressed already:
1) appropriate permissions have been granted to incoming connections via the wildcard ( I know this isn't ideal but I have been trying everything)
2) bind-address isn't the issue 
3) I've restarted and flushed privileges whenever the above changes were made so it's not a matter of just restarting or making sure the server is running.

What I am really struggling with is where I can find the ip address for the shiny app that I am trying to establish a connection with? I looked at the shiny logs and I see "listening on http://X.X.X.X:port". Is this the ip address I should be using? what about the host name ?

I apologize for being a newbie but I feel I must be missing something fairly obvious. I appreciate any and all help and please let me know if I need to elaborate further on what I've mentioned. 

--
